notes.title: Are you ready to bring Ruth Choi's killer to justice?
notes.content:
🔍 Calling All Detectives! 🔍

The moment you've been waiting for is here! We are thrilled to announce the release of our brand-new game, designed to put your investigative skills to the ultimate test. This is no ordinary game—it's a gripping cold case that only the sharpest minds can crack.

🕵️‍♂️Will you convict the wrong person based on seemingly perfect evidence, or will the true killer slip through your fingers due to lack of proof? 

🎥 Watch Interview Tapes: Detectives Munroe and Williams narrowed it down to six suspects. Now, it's your turn. Review the interrogation tapes and catch any details they may have missed. Can you spot the telltale signs of deception?

🔍 Examine Evidence: From witness statements and detective notes to Ruth's diary and autopsy reports, sift through every piece of evidence. Uncover hidden details that lead you closer to the truth.

🧪 Test Evidence: Thanks to modern advancements, you can now test evidence with precision the 90s detectives only dreamed of. Choose the right tests wisely—each piece of evidence has limited samples.

🕵️‍♂️ Build Your Case: Use the Crazy Wall to map out your findings. Pin key pieces of evidence and connect them to suspects with string. Your final connection determines the outcome of the case. Will your evidence be enough to secure a conviction, or will the killer get away?

Are you ready to bring Ruth Choi's killer to justice?

Download Wolf Peak: The Case of Ruth Choi today and immerse yourself in this cold case.

Available now on Steam!

notes.title: Wolf Peak is coming this Friday!
notes.content:
It's finally happening detective. Wolf Peak: The Case of Ruth Choi is coming this Friday. 

Are you up to the task to solve who killed Ruth Choi? 

A game where you can convict the wrong person with the right evidence, or let the true killer get away with it due to lack of evidence.
You are never told outright who the killer is unless you convict the true killer.

Use your own mind and deductive reasoning to find out who killed Ruth Choi.
